title: cimicifuga foetida var. mairei
intro: Cimicifuga foetida var. mairei, commonly known as Actaea mairei or Yew-of-Paracelsus, is a plant species in the family Ranunculaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and anti-anxiety effects, which are attributed to its therapeutic actions such as sedation, analgesia, and anticonvulsant properties. The bioactive constituents of Cimicifuga foetida var. mairei include lignans, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which have been shown to exhibit antioxidant and anti-inflammatory activities. Traditional uses of this plant include treating menstrual disorders, anxiety, and insomnia, as well as its potential application in pain management and as a sedative.
